(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A catheter system for delivering ultrasonic energy to a treatment site within a body lumen, the catheter comprising: a tubular body having a proximal end, a distal end, and an energy delivery section positioned between the proximal end and the distal end; a plurality of ultrasound radiating members positioned within the energy delivery section, the plurality of ultrasound radiating members being allocated into electrical groups comprising more than one ultrasound radiating member; wherein the ultrasound radiating members of one electrical group are spatially interdigitated with the ultrasound radiating members of another electrical group, and wherein the ultrasound radiating members are interdigitated in a non-uniform pattern.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The catheter system of Claim 1, wherein the ultrasound radiating members are interdigitated in a non-uniform pattern.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The catheter system of Claim 1, wherein the ultrasound radiating members are interdigitated in a random pattern.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: A system for treating a patient having pulmonary embolism, the system comprising: a first ultrasound catheter and a second ultrasound catheter, each of the first and second ultrasound catheters comprising a tubular body having a proximal portion and a distal portion, the distal portion comprising an ultrasound energy delivery section having at least one ultrasound element, the tubular body also including at least one fluid delivery lumen; and a control system connected to and configured to operate both the first ultrasound catheter and the second ultrasound catheter.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The system of Claim 6, wherein the control system operates both the first ultrasound catheter and the second ultrasound catheter simultaneously. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 8: The system of Claim 7, wherein the control system is configured to independently control the ultrasound radiating members on the first ultrasound catheter and the second ultrasound catheter.
